data: Apple reported diluted earnings per share of $6.13 in fiscal 2023 (the year ended September 30, 2023), compared with $6.11 in fiscal 2022, an increase of about 0.3%. The small rise came even though net income fell, because Apple's share repurchases reduced the diluted share count from roughly 16.33 billion to about 15.74 billion. Net income for fiscal 2023 was $97.0 billion (about $96.995 billion), down roughly 2.8% from $99.8 billion in fiscal 2022.
